candidates.summary: Email identity binds one verified address to one member and owner; browser sessions never carry agent authority.
Identity unit checks cover address normalization, rolling limits, one-use codes, member continuity, sessions, and SMTP.
Member pages run email verification, sessions, logout, and the self-owner home without owner Basic auth or SSH.
Beta checks: baseline/regression of shared services, local relay hardening, and public Access negatives.
SMTP submission sends verification codes through any provider; credentials stay in the URL and are never logged.
HTTP API separates owner credentials from agent credentials and serves escaped approval forms.
Local QA SMTP sink: stores each received message as a 0600 file. Never use as a real mail service.
Prove product lint detects violations in temporary copies and propagates failure.
